projection: linear discriminant projection fitted on the true clusters

overlap.label: Overlap
overlap.what: cluster spread (standard deviation); larger values make the clusters overlap

anisotropy.label: Elongation
anisotropy.what: anisotropy factor: clusters are stretched along random directions

intra_density.label: Dense cores
intra_density.what: density contrast inside each cluster (dense core, sparse rim)

imbalance.label: Size imbalance
imbalance.what: ratio between the largest and the smallest cluster

eta_int.label: Noise placement
eta_int.what: share of the noise (total 30%) placed between clusters rather than far from them
